services.name: School Tours
services.desc: For more then half a century school tours of the museums have been a valuable resource for teachers and part of growing up in Montana. Fees for school tours are based on a minimum charge of $25.00 for the first thirty individuals. Each additional person is charged .50. Fees include admission to The Museum of the Northern Great Plains & Homestead Village, Museum of the Upper Missouri, Old Fort Benton and the Missouri Breaks Interpretive Center. If you wish to see only the Interpretive Center, there is no charge for students. Museum of the Northern Great Plains - Agriculture and Homestead Era Museum of the Upper Missouri - Steamboat Era and Fort Benton area history Old Fort Benton - Fur Trade
